about: The compound's office (compound.json units id "office"): a 20 ft container painted saffron, raised 0.8 m on a red steel frame with a 1.5 m timber deck in front facing north onto the courtyard, red pipe railings and a stair at the deck's end toward the guest rooms. First in the south row of 20 ft units, the studios' sibling. Furnished (2026-10-29, the founder's layout) as a lounge and a programmer's and gamer's workroom: one L sofa round a low table at the cargo-door end, one big desk with a Studio Display and a Mac Studio across the far end wall, and an Egyptian ahwa set on the deck; in the studio's finishes: off-white linings, oak floor, Medium Oak furniture. The 2D (office-plan.tsx) and the 3D (scripts/site/render/office.html) both read this file. Plan in metres seen from the deck, as the 3D's front view: x to the right from the stair end (the cargo doors, toward the guest rooms; west), y toward the deck (north), the container's centre line at y = 0. Assumptions, not yet sourced: the front is a 3 m band of glazed sliding doors onto the deck, as on the studios (the homepage 3D still draws the office with a door and a window behind a slatted screen); linings 50 mm, inside 5.86 x 2.2 m with 2.3 m to the ceiling; every furniture size is a design choice.

container.about: ISO 20 ft, outside; the floor and ceiling heights are above the container's underside.

glazing.about: Glazed sliding doors in white frames, centred on the front: four panels, two of them slid open behind the others.

deck.about: Eucalyptus boards on the steel frame, the container's length and 1.5 m deep; railings round its three open sides, the stair down off its front corner at the cargo-door end.

cafe.about: The layout (2026-10-29): a traditional Egyptian ahwa set on the deck, in front of the solid wall at the far end, clear of the glazing and the stair: a small round marble-topped table on a cast-iron pedestal, two dark wooden chairs with woven rush seats either side of it, both looking out over the front garden. Plan metres; sizes are design choices.

workstation.about: The layout (2026-10-29): one big desk across the whole far end wall for a programmer and gamer, 0.8 m deep and the room's full 2.2 m wide: a single Apple Studio Display (623 mm wide, its stand foot 168 mm deep) centred on it, a Mac Studio (197 x 197 mm) beside it, a keyboard and mouse, a gaming chair facing the wall. The two Apple sizes are Apple's published dimensions from memory, not yet sourced [A].

sofa.about: The layout (2026-10-29): one L sofa in a single piece, its short leg across the whole width of the cargo-door end wall, its long leg along the back wall, a corner seat where they meet and a low table in front. x1: where the back-wall leg ends; seats: cushions on each leg beside the corner seat.

electric.about: The office's wiring in the studio's pattern (D-021): a surface unit board on the back wall, a double-pole main switch and type 2 surge protection, one RCBO 30 mA type A per circuit, cables in conduit in the linings. The network cabinet and its UPS get a circuit of their own, so the farm's Wi-Fi and cameras ride through on the battery (the power guide puts Wi-Fi and CCTV on the batteries that never stop). The 2026-10-29 layout has no AC and no wall fan (the founder dropped them with the old furniture); a cooling circuit can come back as the spare. The supply is a cable from the farm's site board; its size is the electrician's. Points in plan metres (x, y as the plan, z above the finished floor) at their centre; size in mm (w, h, d). design_A: lights from their watts at 230 V; sockets at the studio's design load (C2), the network circuit at the UPS's input [A]. rwf: the studio BOM's placeholder unit prices (AS-21), not quotes.

circuits.serves: Sockets: the big desk, the sofa and the back wall

network.about: The farm's network starts here, the office taken as the base of the IoT architecture's case A [A]: one 4G router with a second operator's SIM as failover, a PoE switch, the edge gateway (MQTT broker, store-and-forward, local dashboard and the cameras' recorder), all in a small wall cabinet on the office's own circuit and UPS. From the switch: a ceiling access point for the office, the big desk's data outlet, and outdoor cable to the access points and cameras elsewhere on the farm. Signal at the site is [U] until the survey; nothing is sourced or priced yet.
